purpose: Global BIL mechanism training seed; not production KPI data

cases.analysis: PVH uses social intelligence beyond simple brand mentions: it tracks fashion conversations such as OOTD to understand which brands consumers actually wear, share of voice, product trends and changing consumer moods. The reusable mechanism is Social Signal -> Consumer Truth -> Product/Marketing discussion -> Action.

CeraVe demonstrates that platform-specific creator and UGC signals can explain why brand health changes within a sub-audience. BIL should therefore connect social content with audience/platform affinity rather than treating all mentions as homogeneous.

evidence.source: YouGov consumer and brand intelligence case

cases.analysis: The case demonstrates the value of combining social and traditional datasets, historical conversation backtracking and campaign dashboards. BIL should support multi-source evidence and historical comparison rather than isolated social snapshots.

Glossier is useful as a community mechanism benchmark: consumer experience sharing can become advocacy and product/community learning. BIL should distinguish ordinary UGC from advocacy and co-development signals.
Salomon is a useful global creator/community benchmark. BIL should measure creator contribution by content quality, engagement, advocacy and downstream UGC rather than follower count alone.

Audience personas become materially more useful when connected to continuous brand-health tracking. BIL should join audience segments, campaign exposure and Brand Health/Consideration/Purchase Intent over time.

evidence.source: YouGov fashion retailer audience profiling case

cases.analysis: The case is useful for measuring pre/during/post campaign brand health and competitor benchmarks. BIL should preserve time windows and methodology versions so campaign effects are not confused with baseline movement.
Use as a benchmark for globally recognizable visual identity and product-led social culture. Research must separate global attention from local market conversion and store/channel presence.
Use as a benchmark where brand meaning and community behavior are inseparable from product discussion. BIL should connect values-related discourse, product use and local community activity.

Use as a lifecycle stress-test: high historical social visibility must not be interpreted as current commercial health. BIL should compare current momentum, UGC stock, purchase intent and offline presence over time.
